ModMetaData.name: Big and Small - Centaurs Expanded
ModMetaData.author: DanZinagri
ModMetaData.description:
Centaur body genes and xenotypes for the Big and Small framework.
Always available (needs only the framework): - centauroid body gene, using the framework's own centaur art - light centauroid body gene, canine nose gene - Centaur xenotype
Added when Mythic Ages: Megafauna Bestiary is installed: - direhorse body gene, with a coat pattern picked at random per pawn - Dire Centaur and Wooly Centaur xenotypes
Requires Biotech and Big and Small - Framework. Mythic Ages and Genes & More are both optional.
